title: Squared monomial sum
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $S$ be a subset of the $n$ coordinates. On the sign cube, the sum over all points $x$ of the squared monomial at $S$, divided by the square of the cube's cardinality, equals the reciprocal of the cube's cardinality.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a subset of the coordinate set
